units: pt (points) and seconds; positions are in the scene artboard space (hero 390x243, preview 358x208)
clock: One shared time t (s) per scene. Pause when the scene is off-screen or the screen is not focused (v2.3 stops drawing when not visible).

camera.loop: ping-pong: direction flips to -1 at max, +1 at 0
camera.layerOffsetX: translateX = -cam * parallax (per layer, see manifest parallax)

moon.note: In Chill this is a moon; other moods reuse the same disc+glow tinted with palette.glow (a sun in Active/Nature).

entrance.appliesTo: hero only, on first app open (v2.3 passes entrance only to the Home band)

train.notInHero: The Home hero never shows the metro or the train (v2.3 GEOM.band.metro = 0).

beams.x: d.x * midLayerWidth - cam*0.6  (midLayerWidth = 509.000); hide if x < -40 or x > W+40
beams.intensity: it = 0.12 + min(2, matches)*0.36   (matches = places in that district matching the mood; data-driven, values above are the v2.3 demo data)

blend.reactNativeNoNewDeps: normal alpha blending with BOTH opacities x1.5 (clamped to 1). Fitted against v2.3 frames; see _reference/fidelity_report.json

beams.focus: Deferred scope (full City World): focused district it=1.6, others 0.08.

districtPills.x: centre at d.x*midLayerWidth - cam*0.6; left = clamp(x - w/2, 6, W - w - 6)
districtPills.y: base = clamp(d.top - 42, 88, H - 70); try base, base-42, base+42, base-84 to avoid overlap (36 pt rows, 6 pt gaps)
districtPills.show: only districts with matches > 0, and 12 < x < W-12
districtPills.style: height 34, radius 999, padding 0 12 0 9, 12.5/650, white text, bg rgba(7,16,26,.55), 1 pt inner border rgba(255,255,255,.16), 7 pt dot in mood colour with 8 pt glow

reducedMotion: No drift, train, twinkle, pulse or entrance: draw one frame at cam=0, t=0 (v2.3 sets dt=0).

moodChange.note: Only Chill is exported. v2.3 cross-fades palettes over 0.8 s easeInOutCubic and re-renders layers; with baked PNGs, cross-fade two layer sets (opacity) when more moods are exported.

responsive.rule: Treat each scene as one artboard (hero 390x243 pt, preview 358x208 pt). Scale uniformly by k = max(viewW/artW, viewH/artH) ("cover"), anchor bottom-left, let the top of the sky crop. Apply k to every position, size and speed in this file.
responsive.why: v2.3 regenerates the skyline per canvas size; freezing it at the reference artboard keeps the approved composition on every phone. Layers are wider than the artboard by maxCam*parallax, so with k >= viewW/artW the drift range [0, maxCam] never shows an edge.
responsive.heroHeight: v2.3 hero height = safe-area top + 196 pt. The artboard uses 47 + 196 = 243. On devices with a larger inset, cover-scaling crops sky only.

source: pulsecity-v2.3.html scene.js CityScene.step()/draw(), app21.js posPills(); values unchanged from v2.3

winter.source: scene.js CityScene with theme winter (draw(), snowman(), snowfall(), fog()); values unchanged from v2.3

beams.blend: normal (v2.3 uses source-over in winter) - matches exactly in React Native, NO opacity boost

differences.vignette: none in winter; the frost edge replaces it

snowAmt.what: Snow intro amount 0..1. Multiplies opacity of farCaps, midCaps, snowman (whole), every snowflake and the frost edge.
snowAmt.when: Only right after the user switches to Winter Wonderland (v2.3 winterIntro). Otherwise starts at 1.

fog.unusedIndex: fog[2] exists in v2.3 data but is never drawn; kept out deliberately
fog.draw: for k in {-1, 0}: x = fog.x + k*2*W - 0.3*W, y = fog.y - fog.h, size fog.w x 2*fog.h, opacity fog.a * bandAlpha
fog.motion: fog.x += fog.v * 0.016 every animation frame in v2.3 (frame-based). At 60 fps that is fog.v * 0.96 pt/s; wrap fog.x modulo 2*W. Use the per-second value so speed does not depend on frame rate.

snowfall.big: z > 0.93: flake_big sprite 12x12 pt centred on the flake, rotated by phase (radians)
snowfall.respawn: when y > H + 6: y = -6, x = random(0..W)  (v2.3 uses Math.random here)
snowfall.reducedMotion: flakes stay at their initial positions

snowman.note: fixed on screen (no camera parallax), exactly as v2.3 band/panel modes
snowman.parts: snowman_body, snowman_head, snowman_front, snowman_arm share one box. Place each at left = x + box.x0*scale, top = y + box.y0*scale, size box.w*scale x box.h*scale; draw in that order.

motion.headRotation: tilt around (x + 0, y - 48*scale) (on top of the whole rotation)
motion.armRotation: wave around (x + 9*scale, y - 33*scale) (arm sprite already includes its -0.6 rad rest angle)

moods.assets: one set per surface/theme/mood (asset-manifest lookup); colours are baked, never tint at runtime

glowBoost.winter: none (v2.3 blends beams normally in winter)
glowBoost.appliesTo: normal-blend opacity multiplier for v2.3 additive effects in City World: beam column, beam halo, car streaks, Surprise cone and flash. Clamp opacity to 1. Fitted per mood against v2.3 frames.

moods.beamMatches: district matches per mood are in each set's scene JSON (districts[].matches); recompute from live data in the app

moodCrossfade.source: scene.js setMood()/retarget()/step(): palette lerp over 0.8 s with easeInOutCubic, layers re-rendered each frame
moodCrossfade.reactNative: mount the new mood set above the old one and fade it in: opacity 0 -> 1 over 800 ms, easeInOutCubic; then unmount the old set. Data-driven values (beam intensity, traffic, pill visibility) switch to the new mood at the start.
moodCrossfade.difference: v2.3 blends palettes; an image cross-fade blends pixels. Start and end frames are identical; mid-transition colours differ slightly.
moodCrossfade.theme: theme switch City <-> Winter uses the same 0.8 s cross-fade, plus snowAmt 0 -> 1 over 1.4 s on entering Winter

fullScreen.source: scene.js mode full; app21.js City World (r_cityworld) + Surprise (r_surprise)

camera.drift: none on City World; Surprise screen drifts like the hero (6 pt/s ping-pong) until Surprise starts
camera.drag: horizontal drag: cam -= dx/0.6 (mid layer follows the finger 1:1), clamp 0..maxCam; on release, velocity camV = -dx/0.6/dt
camera.focusDistrict: camTarget = camForDistrict(id); each frame cam = lerp(cam, camTarget, 1 - 0.003^dt); stop when within 0.5 pt

fullScreen.entrance: same as hero (1.8 s, far +20 pt, mid +36 pt and fade from 15%) when the screen opens with motion on

beams.focused: when a district is selected: it = 1.6 for it, 0.08 for the others

pills.show: all districts (not only matches) when 12 < x < W-12
pills.x: centre d.x*midWidth - cam*0.6; left = clamp(x - w/2, 6, W - w - 6)
pills.y: base = clamp(d.top - 42, H*0.34, H - 70); try base, base-42, base+42, base-84 avoiding overlaps (36 pt rows, 6 pt gaps)

lanes.0: warm headlights (car_head), moving right, y = H*0.87, streak extends LEFT of x (flip car_head horizontally)
lanes.1: red tail lights (car_tail), moving left, y = H*0.9, streak extends RIGHT of x

cars.x: car.x * nearLayerWidth - cam (screen pt); hide if x < -30 or x > W+30
cars.motion: car.x = (car.x + dir*car.v*traffic*dt*0.03 + 1) mod 1, dir = +1 lane 0, -1 lane 1
cars.length: 12 + 20*car.v*traffic pt (traffic per palette, in scene JSON)
cars.opacity: City 0.95, Winter 0.6, times glowBoost in City
cars.blend: v2.3 additive in both themes; React Native normal alpha
cars.initial: cars[] in the full set scene JSON

snowmen.positions: full winter scene JSON snowmen[] (layerX, y, scale, k). screen x = layerX - cam*0.6; hide if outside [-40, W+40]
snowmen.sprites: parts exported at scale 1.35 (largest); draw each snowman at its own scale by sizing the parts to box*scale (downscale only)
snowmen.motion: tilt = 0.06*sin(1.3t + k), wave = 0.5*sin(2.4t + 2k); otherwise as hero

fullScreen.snowfall: 110 flakes (full winter scene JSON), same rules as hero

surpriseMe.surface: full (same assets as full-screen City World of the current theme/mood)

sequence.camera: e = easeInOutCubic(p); cam = lerp(from, to, e) + sin(e*pi) * W*0.25 * (to >= from ? -1 : 1)  (overshoot)
sequence.cone: City only: from apex (W/2, H+20) to target (tx, ty); tx = targetX + sin(p*14)*(1-p)*80 (wobble), ty = district top
sequence.snow: Winter only (no cone): flakes pulled toward an orbit around the target: x = lerp(x, tx + cos(phase+3t)*(10+24z), g*0.85), y = lerp(y, ty + sin(phase+3t)*(10+20z), g*0.85), g = easeInOutCubic(p)

sequence.flash: radius R = 16 + 130*p pt, opacity 0.9*(1-p) (City times glowBoost), surprise_flash sprite sized 2R centred on target
sequence.snow: Winter: flakes stay in the orbit (g = 1)

sequence.event: onLock(x, y): show the result card at the target
sequence.dim: stays 0.45 while the card is open; after clearing, falls at 1.5/s

cone.sprite: surprise_cone (400 pt long, apex at left-centre)
cone.place: translate to apex, rotate by atan2(ty-by, tx-bx), size = (len, spriteH*len/400) with len = hypot(tx-bx, ty-by) + 30
cone.blend: v2.3 additive; normal alpha in React Native

surpriseMe.targets: a random district that has a valid demo pick (app logic); targetX = d.x*midWidth - cam*0.6, targetY = d.top (scene JSON)
surpriseMe.skip: tap skips to the end of lock: cam = to, phase done
surpriseMe.reducedMotion: jump to the target camera, dimA = 0.45, no cone/flash animation, fire onLock immediately
surpriseMe.knownDifference: At lock-on, v2.3 additive halos clip into a slightly square glow; the exported sprites render it round.
